blocks.text: II. MEDICAL HISTORY: Item 18.m., Mental disorders of any sort; depression, anxiety, etc.
blocks.html: II. MEDICAL HISTORY: Item 18.m., Mental disorders of any sort; depression, anxiety, etc.

blocks.text: An affirmative answer to Item 18.m. requires investigation through supplemental history taking. Dispositions will vary according to the details obtained and the condition(s) being treated. An applicant with an established history of a personality disorder that is severe enough to have repeatedly manifested itself by overt acts, a psychosis disorder, or a bipolar disorder must be denied or deferred by the AME.

V. PHARMACEUTICAL CONSIDERATIONS

blocks.text: Individuals exhibiting symptoms, regardless of the treatment used, must not fly.
blocks.html: Individuals exhibiting symptoms, regardless of the treatment used, must not fly.

blocks.text: - Symptoms must be controlled without adverse side effects.

blocks.text: Individuals can be considered for first, second, or third-class medical certificates while being treated with one of several specific antidepressants.
